digest.component_or_area: rebar repository documentation and GitHub metadata
propositions: A batch of eight approved documentation and metadata tasks (F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, F19, F20) must be implemented in rebar against approved survey recommendations from sessions minimum-rainy-fawn and homemade-coltish-donkey.
Documentation changes must align README, operation certificates, ADR 0100 command discovery, MCP summaries, and configuration contracts with current implementations and route registry.
F20 must update only the GitHub About description via gh repo edit to lead with enforceable plan review and signed completion verification, leaving repository files, topics, and homepage unchanged.
All repository children must pass applicable local checks, LLM-Review +1, and Verified +1 before merge, with F20 requiring exact authenticated readback of the approved 236-character description.
All eight children must land independently as reviewable Gerrit changes, rebase sequentially from origin/main, and merge without forced transitions before closure.
